title: UAV Image Positioning: Deep-Learning-Supported Geolocalization via Template Matching
description: Flight-side companion code of the article 'Learned versus Classical Structural Representations for GNSS-Denied UAV Localization by Template Matching: A Cross-Source Map Benchmark and Flight Replay' (submitted to the International Journal of Engineering and Geosciences): UAV frame normalization (undistortion, heading rotation, DEM-aided GSD scaling), cross-autoencoder transformation and multi-scale NCC template matching against a georeferenced reference map, with three-crop consensus and route evaluation tooling.
